notes.title: 2025/03/05 Update log
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I have made some updates to the game on March 5th, 2023. The content of this update is as follows
1. Fixed a bug that caused the broker market to not refresh due to repeated hiring and firing of economic agents
2. Fixed a bug that caused problems with the team lineup due to the signing of our own players
3. Fixed a bug where the emotional state cannot be correctly restored when the residential area is bustling
4. Optimized the response speed of the Play button

notes.title: 2025/03/01 update log
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. I made some updates to the game on March 1, 2025. The content of this update is as follows
1. Updated a simple help module to help new friends understand our game faster
2. Adjusted the calculation method of player value, and now the player value is closer to the real world
3. The bug caused by dynamic transfer has been fixed. This bug will cause the weekly settlement and season settlement to not be carried out normally, so that the leaderboard data will not be updated every season. Now we have fixed this problem
4. Fixed that the liquidated damages for endorsements and investments signed by commercial brokers when players choose to terminate the contract will not be correctly displayed in the weekly settlement
5. We have adjusted the archive structure. Before the adjustment, players often crash the game when archiving, resulting in bad files. We have redefined the archive data structure to bring better experience to players
This update requires players to re open the file, so please forgive me for the inconvenience caused to players
